title: When does resistivity resolve elastic ambiguity? Reproducibility archive
description: Code, frozen synthetic results, publication-figure generation, and the Oman GT3A external control used to test when resistivity improves elastic rock-physics inversion and how the result changes when transport processes are missing from the fitted models.
